problem.title: Search a 2D Matrix
problem.problemStatement: Given an N × M matrix satisfying: Each row is sorted in ascending order. The first element of each row is greater than the last element of the previous row. Determine whether a target value exists in the matrix.
problem.input: Integer N Integer M Matrix matrix Integer target
problem.output: true if the target exists, otherwise false.
